import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { users } from "./users";
import { oauthAccessGrants } from "./oauth_access_grants";
import { oauthAccessTokens } from "./oauth_access_tokens";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "owner_type" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "name" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "uid" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "secret" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "scopes" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const oauthApplications = defineTable("oauth_applications", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
        ownerType: col.text().notNull(),
        ownerId: col.bigint({ mode: "number" }).notNull(),
        name: col.text().notNull(),
        uid: col.text().notNull().unique(),
        secret: col.text().notNull(),
        redirectUri: col.text().notNull().validate({ url: true }),
        scopes: col.text().notNull().default(""),
        confidential: col.boolean().notNull().default(true),
        createdAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull(),
        updatedAt: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }).notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        owner: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        oauth_access_grants: rel.hasMany(() => oauthAccessGrants, { foreignKey: "application_id" }),
        oauth_access_tokens: rel.hasMany(() => oauthAccessTokens, { foreignKey: "application_id" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
